title: Look at the image. Read the text. Read it again.
paragraphs: Look at the image. Read the text. Read it again.
This is the ultimate spiritual power move. The enemy wants a reaction. Chaos wants your attention. People want to drag you down to their level.

Your peace is too expensive to spend on cheap situations. The moment you react in anger or fear, you hand over the keys to your peace of mind. Keep your armor on, guard your heart, and starve the negativity of the reaction it craves.
⚔️ "Better a patient person than a warrior, one with self-control than one who takes a city." - Proverbs 16:32
